title: LYTCHAT – Messaging & Communication Platform
summary: LYNQ is a modern messaging and communication platform designed to bring people closer through real-time conversations, user connections and media sharing. Built as a progressive web application, LYNQ delivers a responsive communication experience across supported devices.
challenge: Digital communication platforms need to provide convenient, responsive and reliable ways for people to connect. The challenge was to create a modern messaging experience that brings conversations, user connections and media sharing together while remaining accessible across different devices.
solution:
TOP TECH developed LYNQ as a modern progressive web application focused on bringing people closer through digital communication. The platform is designed around real-time messaging, user authentication, connections and media sharing, with a responsive interface for supported devices.

LYNQ uses Firebase services for authentication and communication-related backend functionality, with media storage and delivery integrations configured for the project. Its PWA architecture provides an app-like experience through supported web browsers and devices.
